Name: Greenwave Systems Inc - Wavely
Description:
Our goal is to connect customers seamlessly to any IoT device, anywhere in the world. To achieve this, we partner with 500 of the world’s leading mobile carriers covering 180 countries and territories.

We are empowering service providers and IoT stakeholders to develop richer networks, smarter services and connected devices with the Wavely Platform.

Greenwave Systems is a privately held, VC-backed company with offices in Irvine, California, Copenhagen, Denmark and Helsinki, Finland.
